description.value: L'aromas Coffee Southlands is one of four locations of a Delta-based coffee brand that grew from a backyard roasting project and community market presence into a local café chain, officially opening its first location in July 2015. Founded by three friends with a mission to create a 'home away from home,' the brand is community-rooted and independently owned. The Southlands location offers a full café experience with outdoor seating and on-site washrooms.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack (8 spaces) at 5m; rack at 15m; rack at 21m; rack at 29m; rack (6 spaces) at 65m; rack (6 spaces) at 65m. Total: 20 spaces.

OSM tags provide toilets=yes (washrooms confirmed) and outdoor_seating=yes; the website's 'Order Online' feature and café format support takeout. No bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned in either the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null.
